day_focus: Be present with Maria and the kids — Strategy Saturday is for planning the week, not producing it.
checkin: Haircut's on the board this morning, son; get that done early so the rest of the day stays free. Boaz turns 15 in eight days — let a little of today be about him without turning it into a project. Maria carries a lot; your best work today is noticing her and the watch crew. The Lord already knows the plan — show up for the people He put under your roof.
